 ❯ Write three short paragraphs about terminal multiplexers.                                                     14:22 ┃
                                                                                                                       ┃
 ● Terminal multiplexers let users manage several terminal sessions inside one terminal window. Tools such as tmux,    ┃
   GNU Screen, and Zellij provide panes, tabs or windows, and session controls that help organize work. They are       ┃
   especially useful when a developer is compiling code, monitoring logs, editing files, and running servers           ┃
   simultaneously.                                                                                                     ┃
                                                                                                                       ┃
   One major advantage is session persistence. A multiplexer keeps processes running when the connection to a remote   ┃
   server is interrupted or when a local terminal is closed. Users can later reconnect and resume the same working     ┃
   environment rather than restarting jobs and recreating layouts. This capability makes terminal multiplexers         ┃
   valuable for remote administration and long-running tasks.                                                          ┃
                                                                                                                       ┃
   Terminal multiplexers are also highly configurable. Keyboard shortcuts can create panes, switch sessions, copy      ┃
   text, and control layouts, while configuration files support custom themes and workflows. Although the learning     ┃
   curve can feel significan                                                                                           ┃
